subject: AWS marketplace deal enablement – reseller onboarding & private offer timeline
messages:
From: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluecrest-resell.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + AWS marketplace private offer for Redwood deal

Hi Soojin,

Thanks for the quick intro on LinkedIn last week. BlueCrest has a persistent outbound opportunity with a mid-market SaaS customer that would benefit from a CPPO-style private offer to simplify procurement and apply reseller margin. We wanted to confirm Redwood's preferred workflow for:

- Getting a price proposal finalized with the AWS account team,
- Drafting any reseller SOW language we need to include, and
- The fastest way to surface the private offer to the end customer (DocuSign vs AWS PO flow).

High level timeline we are aiming for: pricing and paperwork by 10/09, private offer live for customer review by 10/12. Can your team support a short enablement call this week so we can align roles?

Attaching our standard marketplace MOP template for your finance/legal review.

Thanks,
Ethan
Director, GTM Partnerships
BlueCrest Resell
(attachment: reseller_mop_template.xlsx)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluecrest-resell.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T11:07:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + AWS marketplace private offer for Redwood deal

Hi Ethan — great to meet you, and thanks for the template. High level yes, we can run the timeline you suggested provided a couple of dependencies are met:

1) Final list price (MSRP + reseller margin) and any promo term for the customer by EOD 10/06.
2) AWS account manager confirmation that a CPPO is allowed under the account limits and the correct seller account ID is used.
3) Redline of the SOW language by our legal (Laura) by 10/08 so BlueCrest can include it with the private offer.

I copied Sergio (partner ops) and Priyom (channel sales) so they can pick up operational pieces. Laura, I can drop a draft SOW and our standard marketplace checklist — can you do a 24–48 hour review?

Proposed short enablement call: 10/05 at 10:30 PT (30m). If that works, I’ll send a calendar invite and include an agenda: roles, price approval flow, DocuSign vs AWS signature flow, and the handoff checklist.

Thanks — Soojin
Head of Channel GTM, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_draft_sow_v1.docx)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-05T08:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + AWS marketplace private offer for Redwood deal

On Mon, Oct 5, 2026 at 07:30 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Proposed short enablement call: 10/05 at 10:30 PT (30m).

I reviewed the draft SOW you attached. Quick notes:

- Add a one-paragraph data handling clause referencing Redwood Private deployments (customer data scope) — I marked this in the doc.
- Insert our standard indemnity limitation paragraph (we can use the same negotiated language we used with Acme last quarter).
- Payment terms: prefer net 30, but we can accept net 45 for the first engagement if the reseller requires a longer window — finance will confirm.

I can turn around a redline by end of day 10/06. Please surface any customer-specific contractual asks before EOD tomorrow.

Laura
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_draft_sow_v1.docx - redline pending)

From: Anika Rao (AWS Seller) <anika.rao@amazon.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Ethan Cole <ethan.cole@bluecrest-resell.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-06T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + AWS marketplace private offer for Redwood deal

Hi all — following up from the enablement call earlier. Per AWS CPPO process:

- BlueCrest must submit the private offer request through Seller Central referencing Redwood's Seller ID (I confirmed the account: 012345678901).
- We require the final list price, term length, and any promotional credits in the request.
- DocuSign is fine for the SOW between Redwood and the end customer, but CPPO submission still needs the offer payload uploaded in Seller Central so the customer sees the official private offer.

I uploaded the CPPO checklist we use on our side (see attached) and initiated a request to AWS Seller Support to reserve the offer slot pending your final price. If you can post the finalized pricing by 10/08 morning, we should be able to have the private offer visible to the customer by 10/12 and have them accept within your targeted window.

Next steps summary:
- BlueCrest: confirm margin and submit private offer payload into Seller Central (contact Ethan).
- Redwood: finalize redline SOW and confirm Seller ID and price by 10/08 (Sooj in + Laura).
- AWS: Acknowledge receipt and keep offer slot reserved until 10/11.

Thanks,
Anika
AWS Marketplace Seller Enablement
(attachment: aws_private_offer_checklist.pdf)
